Are [like] an earthen{H2789} vessel overlaid{H6823} with silver{H3701} dross.{H5509} 24 He that hateth{H8130} dissembleth{H5234} with his lips;{H8193} But he layeth up{H7896} deceit{H4820} within{H7130} him: 25 When he speaketh{H6963} fair,{H2603} believe{H539} him not; For there are seven{H7651} abominations{H8441} in his heart:{H3820} 26 Though [his] hatred{H8135} cover{H3680} itself with guile,{H4860} His wickedness{H7451} shall be openly showed{H1540} before the assembly.{H6951} 27 Whoso diggeth{H3738} a pit{H7845} shall fall{H5307} therein; And he that rolleth{H1556} a stone,{H68} it shall return{H7725} upon him. 28 A lying{H8267} tongue{H3956} hateth{H8130} those whom it hath wounded;{H1790} And a flattering{H2509} mouth{H6310} worketh{H6213} ruin.{H4072}
